# Von Neumann algebra generated by all-state GNS coefficients

Let `A` be a nonunital
complex C-star algebra. Let `H_u` be the Hilbert direct sum of the GNS spaces of all
positive bounded functionals of norm one, and `π_u : A →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] B(H_u)` their
coordinatewise GNS representation. `universalStateEnvelopingAlgebra A` is the von Neumann
algebra generated by `π_u(A)`, the double commutant of the unital star algebra generated
by these operators.
